selected_evidence.requirement: Create the local certificate authority named OS Comparison Root CA
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the exact subject and issuer, CA:TRUE constraint, SHA-256 signature, and matching private key.

selected_evidence.requirement: Install the certificate as a trusted system certificate authority
selected_evidence.summary: The native update added one certificate; verification through `/etc/ssl/certs` and the consolidated CA bundle returned OK.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Ubuntu 16.04.7 LTS and kernel 4.4.0-210-generic were unchanged before and after the work.
Captures the healthy pre-restart trust state and boot ID, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered persistent CA, key, trust links, and system trust verification.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf '%s\n' '--- os-release ---'
cat /etc/os-release
printf '%s\n' '--- kernel ---'
uname -a
printf '%s\n' '--- boot-id ---'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '%s\n' '--- trust tooling ---'
command -v openssl
openssl version
command -v update-ca-certificates
printf '%s\n' '--- existing matching CA files ---'
find /usr/local/share/ca-certificates /etc/ssl/certs -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -iname '*os*comparison*' -o -iname '*comparison*root*' \) -print 2>/dev/null || true

commands.command:
set -eu
umask 077
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:4096 -nodes -sha256 -days 3650 -keyout /tmp/os-comparison-root-ca.key -out /tmp/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -subj '/CN=OS Comparison Root CA' -config /etc/ssl/openssl.cnf -extensions v3_ca >/tmp/os-comparison-ca-gen.log 2>&1
printf '%s\n' 'generated certificate:'
openssl x509 -in /tmp/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -noout -subject -issuer -serial -dates
printf '%s\n' 'CA extensions:'
openssl x509 -in /tmp/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -noout -text | grep -A4 'X509v3 Basic Constraints'
printf 'private-key mode='
stat -c '%a' /tmp/os-comparison-root-ca.key

commands.command:
set -eu
sudo -n install -o root -g root -m 0600 /tmp/os-comparison-root-ca.key /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
sudo -n install -o root -g root -m 0644 /tmp/os-comparison-root-ca.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
sudo -n update-ca-certificates
rm -f /tmp/os-comparison-root-ca.key /tmp/os-comparison-root-ca.crt /tmp/os-comparison-ca-gen.log
printf '%s\n' 'installed file modes:'
sudo -n stat -c '%a %U:%G %n' /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
printf '%s\n' 'generated trust-store links:'
find /etc/ssl/certs -maxdepth 1 -type l -lname '*os-comparison-root-ca.pem' -printf '%f -> %l\n'

commands.command:
set -eu
CERT=/usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
printf '%s\n' '--- current boot identity ---'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '%s\n' '--- installed CA identity and constraints ---'
openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -subject -issuer -fingerprint -sha256
openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -text | grep -A1 'X509v3 Basic Constraints'
printf '%s\n' '--- native system trust verification ---'
openssl verify -CApath /etc/ssl/certs "$CERT"
openssl verify -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt "$CERT"
printf '%s\n' '--- private key correspondence ---'
CERT_MOD=$(openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -modulus | openssl sha256)
KEY_MOD=$(sudo -n openssl rsa -in /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key -noout -modulus 2>/dev/null | openssl sha256)
[ "$CERT_MOD" = "$KEY_MOD" ]
printf '%s\n' 'certificate and private key: MATCH'
printf '%s\n' '--- installed OS and kernel remain unchanged ---'
grep '^PRETTY_NAME=' /etc/os-release
uname -r

printf '%s\n' 'certificate and private key: MATCH'
